The '''2026 ATP Masters 1000''' is the thirty-seventh edition of the [[ATP 1000]] Series. The event series is named as such as the champions of each ATP 1000 event are awarded 1,000 rankings points.<ref>{{Cite web |title=What is the 2026 ATP Tour calendar? |url=https://www.atptour.com/en/news/what-is-the-2026-atp-tour-calendar |website=[[ATP Tour]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=2026 ATP Calendar |url=https://www.atptour.com/-/media/files/calendar-pdfs/2025/2026-atp-tour-calendar-december-2025.pdf |website=[[ATP Tour]]}}</ref>
